summary: Regression pass after CORS hardening, useCallback refactor in 5 admin managers, stable-key React fixes. All 27 backend tests PASS. Public site + admin CMS fully functional with ZERO console errors, ZERO React key warnings, ZERO failed network requests. No infinite request loops on any admin tab (verified by 3-second idle observation). PagesManager auto-selects Homepage tab and shows editable fields on tab open. Home page save round-trip (edit -> save toast -> restore -> save toast) works and data persisted. Wine CRUD via UI (create TEST wine, delete via native confirm) works end-to-end. Backend CORS confirmed hardened (explicit FRONTEND_URL, credentials=true; unknown origins get 400).

cors_hardening.public_url_backend_direct_unknown_origin: returns 400 Bad Request with no allow-origin header
cors_hardening.note: The Kubernetes ingress adds access-control-allow-origin: * to responses at the edge, but the backend itself enforces the explicit-origin policy. Frontend calls are same-origin so CORS is not triggered.

admin_tabs_no_loop.note: Initial load count of 2 per tab is React 18 StrictMode dev double-mount behavior, not a useCallback loop. Zero requests during idle after mount confirms no infinite loop.

general_regression.contact_form_submit_success_toast: Thank you — your inquiry has been received. We'll be in touch shortly.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/pages/{key} is destructive full-replace of the content object. It works fine for the admin UI (which always POSTs the full merged content), but any partial-update client would clobber sibling fields. Not urgent, but a PATCH/merge variant would be safer.

The existing backend_test.py had a destructive test_update_page that wiped the seeded home content (setting only hero_title + extra). Fixed in this iteration: test now reads original, merges a marker, verifies persist, then restores original. Live home page has been restored to the correct 'Wines woven from heritage & craft' seed value.

test_get_wine_by_slug was still pointing at the old catalog slug 'celtic-oak-cabernet-2021' which no longer exists after the 13-wine catalog refactor. Updated to 'old-vine-zinfandel-2024' which is in the current seed.
seed_data_creation: None. Created and cleaned up: 1 TEST wine (created via admin UI then deleted), 1 TEST contact submission (deleted via API), 1 test_marker key on home page (removed as part of test flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 = regression after CORS hardening + useCallback hook-dep refactor + stable-key fixes. All PASS. Catalog now has 13 wines (9 Estate + 4 Train Graffiti). Home page seed keys: hero_overline, hero_title, hero_subtitle, intro_overline, intro_title, intro_body (no 'title' key — the review-request mention of data-testid='page-field-title' was a minor typo; actual field is page-field-hero_title). Existing backend_test.py test_update_page previously clobbered home page content; now fixed to be non-destructive. Public URL for testing: https://vineyard-heritage-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend CORS enforcement works at the app level but the ingress adds '*' at the edge — verify via localhost:8001 for the real backend behavior if CORS is retested.
